questions.text:
Question 21.  
Variables a, b and c are called ________________? 
A) instance variables 
B) fields 
C) class variables 
 
D) both A and B. 
E) A, B, and C
questions.explanation:
Field and instance variable have the same meaning. They are variables that contained 
within and belong to each instance of the class (every object that is instantiate from that 
class). A class variable is a static variable. There is only one class variable regardless of 
how many objects are instantiated from the class.
